description: src/sqllens/config.py:108-115 DatabaseConfig is not frozen and does not validate on assignment, so assignment or model_copy(update=...) bypasses the url scheme rule.

Supported-scheme rule duplicated with disagreeing predicates: config validator vs startswith('mysql') in src/sqllens/agent/factory.py:250, src/sqllens/preflight.py:115 and sqlglot_dialect_for_url (readonly.py:186-188), so mysqlx:// reaches the MySQL branch for direct callers.
src/sqllens/eval/compare.py:14-17 _SQLGLOT_DIALECT_MAP keeps mssql and mariadb entries that config loading now refuses.

tests/unit/test_safety_whole_row.py:146-167 deleted the only mixed-case CTE-qualifier row, leaving the guard's normalize_identifiers call (whole_row.py:140) untested under dialect None; it could have been ported to a kept dialect.

tests/unit/test_safety.py:1177 new MySQL row of test_call_after_nested_comment_markers_is_checked is refused by the nested-comment check (readonly.py:512) before the function denylist runs, so it does not test the call check its name describes.

docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md:272 says TestSelectIntoRejected covers MySQL 'as SELECT ... INTO @var', but the base-form MySQL row is 'SELECT * INTO new_tbl FROM users' (tests/unit/test_safety.py:574), so the parenthetical misdescribes the MySQL cases.

src/sqllens/safety/rls.py:315-317 rewritten normalize_functions=False rationale names only a consequence that is harmless on MySQL/SQLite (case-insensitive function names); the real constraint is the pinned output in tests/unit/test_safety_rls.py:217-228.

docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md:104 (untouched) says SET SESSION MAX_EXECUTION_TIME applies on 'MySQL 5.7.4+ / MariaDB'; MariaDB has no MAX_EXECUTION_TIME and is unsupported, conflicting with this iteration's MariaDB cleanup of cleanup-error-handling.md.

src/sqllens/agent/integrations/mysql/sql_runner.py:128-131 (untouched) repeats 'MAX_EXECUTION_TIME ... MySQL 5.7.4+ / MariaDB', inconsistent with the diff's own edit of the finally: comment at line 173.
DatabaseConfig.dialect returns the scheme's raw case and any sqlite-prefixed text, leaving normalization to callers.
claude-desktop install --dry-run returns a clean plan for a database URL the new scheme check refuses, because the dry run returns before validate_toml.

docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md:37 says sqlglot parses MySQL INTO OUTFILE / INTO DUMPFILE as exp.Select with args['into'] so the SELECT ... INTO check refuses them; under the locked sqlglot 30.31.0 they raise ParseError and are refused only by the parse-failure path. The _BYPASS_CORPUS entries at tests/unit/test_safety.py:208-209 carry no match=, so neither reason is pinned.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py:633-636 new comment repeats that SELECT ... INTO file writes parse as exp.Select with args['into'] and are caught by this branch; INTO OUTFILE / DUMPFILE never reach it because the parse fails first.

tests/unit/test_safety.py:564-569 new TestSelectIntoRejected docstring says SELECT ... INTO writes files on MySQL and parses with args['into'] set; the class covers only INTO @var and INTO new_tbl forms, and file forms do not have that parse shape.

src/sqllens/agent/factory.py:233 rewritten build_sql_runner docstring line is about 127 characters, over the project's 100-character limit; src/sqllens/agent/ is excluded from ruff so lint does not catch it.
